oh and also the 7 Pro design is elegant, feels really premium and in hand feel is really great. I always get the white/snow ones, I used to joke that my 3XL was my "space phone", looked like something that belonged on the space shuttle. So the strong points of Pixel are very strong and mostly redeeming which makes it all the more frustrating that it has irritating little and sometimes not so little bugs that none of the other manufacturers have as far as I'm aware, even on their mid rangers. You wonder how a company like Google who make such great smartphones in many other ways can get these basics wrong sometimes at a 2014 HTC level with the earlier Tensors now which beggars belief. However I will not do away with this camera, the free VPN, up to date updates and all the other good [...] I just can't understand it, Google is way behind other phone brands on sound/speakers.

Its frustrating after spending so much money on a phone to feel like my reliable old iPhone 8 Plus is actually better in a lot of ways
